frames.caption: Choose a rectangle as the host.
The radial partition rule is licensed inside the circle's own vocabulary.
Transplant the radial partition rule onto the rectangle, cut into 8: the pieces are unequal.
Hybridized model of 1/8: a foreign partition rule on an illicit host.
Establish the whole bar. One length, not yet partitioned.
Partition the bar into parts of different sizes. There is no unit fraction because the parts are unequal.
Shade some parts. Because the parts are unequal, the shaded amount is not the intended fraction.
Establish the whole bar. One length, not yet partitioned.
Partition the bar into equal parts, but make the wrong number: count the cuts, not the regions.
